execution: Live JHCR update sequence 15 in the already-running, JHCR-instrumented OrcX01 map; API status 1 dispatched PF_Start, which wrote PF_META/PF_SETUP/PF_DONE.
scenario: One Apxf hphx and one enemy hfoo. Target x was forced every 0.05 simulation seconds to 650 units for 10s, 550 for 10s, then 300 for 10s. A 1-damage UnitDamageTarget event validated the listener before the target life was restored.

observations.at_650_units: No Phoenix-source damage event; target life remained 100000 through the 10-second phase.
observations.at_550_units: Phoenix-source damage began 0.605s after moving into range; target life then fell during the phase.
observations.at_300_units: Phoenix-source damage continued during the final phase.
observations.source_identity: GetEventDamageSource() and the test Phoenix had the same GetHandleId() in recorded events.
observations.jhcr_handle_comparison: JHCR-evaluated unit equality returned false even when GetHandleId() values were equal, including the positive control. The sourceMatch boolean in raw records is invalid; handle IDs are the identity evidence.

conclusion: For this Retail build and target setup, Apxf damages a target at 550 units and does not damage it at 650 units. This brackets the effective boundary between 550 and 650 and is consistent with AbilityData Area=600.
